name: Bakhoor wood chips
where: Ajmal official stores, Dubai Mall, and other shops
about: Bakhoor is a Gulf tradition for scenting homes. These are wood chips coated in fragrance oil. Charcoal and lighters are not included.
tip: Buy the chips only. Charcoal and lighters are sold separately.

name: Al Nassma camel milk chocolate
where: Al Nassma stores or Dubai Duty Free
about: This chocolate is made with camel milk, a local specialty of the UAE. It is a popular gift from Dubai.
tip: Some public sellers show it as sold out. Ask about stock before you go.

name: Dubai chocolate
where: Fix Dessert Chocolatier and other authentic shops, or airport duty free
about: Dubai chocolate is a famous sweet treat that began in the city. It is known for its crunchy filling and smooth chocolate shell.
tip: Buy only from authentic shops. Check that the store is genuine before you pay.
